run_replace_random_passes: run replace random passes on a PyTorch FX graph to use backend-native random operations
fuse_seed_creation_pass: fuse seed creation calls on the same device into a single seeds call with lookup
replace_random_ops: replace aten rand and randn operations with inductor native random prims in an FX graph
replace_randint_ops: replace aten randint operations with inductor native randint prims in an FX graph
get_device: resolve the default torch device when a device argument is None
